Pieces (solid tiles, palette gate 2/7, worst CVD pair dE 16): I lightning lavender #C9B5FF, O sulphur #F4C430, T incandescent orange #FF6A1F, S ember crimson #C21E3A, Z storm blue #2673E6, J olivine #33B07A, L ash white #EDE6DA, garbage cooled basalt #2B2422.
keyMotifs: An erupting breached stratovolcano with a somma wall; lava rivers as a surface (distance-field channels, crust rafts and plates drifting over an incandescent core, glowing seams and levee cracks); a fissure curtain of fire; an eruption column (a ray-marched volume of cauliflower lobes lit from below) bending into a pyrocumulonimbus anvil with mammatus; volcanic ("dirty thunderstorm") lightning: cloud-to-ground bolts, spider lightning, a great discharge; St Elmo's fire; incandescent bombs; a Vulcanian shock front; a volcanic vortex ring.
motion: Lava crust drifts downstream; the fountain and the fissure jet in closed-form arcs; the column's lobes climb its axis, churn and grow as it widens; the storm lives at rest (a slow glow inside the cloud, a crawler every few seconds); embers climb off the rivers at the near corners and ash falls past the eye; heat shimmer over the lava; stars twinkle; the lens breathes and follows the pointer.
gameplayFx: Lock: a Strombolian burst, bombs (as many as the piece's cells) arcing out leaning the way the piece locked and splashing on the cone, tinted by the piece colour. Hard drop: a bigger burst, sparks, a tremor tearing the crust open along every channel. Clear: one cloud-to-ground bolt per line out of the column (higher rows strike higher up the cone), scorch and sparks at the strike, the column lit from inside, the fountain kicks. Chain: the storm charges, spider lightning along the anvil, the fountain climbs; a long chain's break discharges it in a great branched bolt to the summit. Four lines: a Vulcanian blast (one crater flash, a torn shock front through the column, a ring of bombs, the fountain at twice its height, a glowing surge down the breach, the bolts). T-spin: a vortex ring (a hot inner ring inside a sooty outer one) rises and widens beside the column. Back-to-back: St Elmo's corona on the summit. Perfect: sheet lightning sweeps the anvil, a crown of four bolts round the summit, the fountain at its highest. Level up: the night moves a watch, the fountain kicks and fresh lava surges down every channel with a glowing wake.
tech: Node materials only (MeshBasicNodeMaterial, self-shaded), WebGPU with the WebGL2 backend. Land: a polar fan round the eye (exponential rows) plus the volcano's own ring mesh, from one CPU height function, baked in slices in PyrestormWorld.prepare. Lava: two nested RGBA8 distance fields (centreline distance, half-width, heat, glow; heading, kind, arc length) with a pixel-width antialiased edge, a two-phase flow map and a blackbody ramp. Column: a ray-marched volume inside a tube proxy round its curved axis (12-40 steps by tier, early out when opaque): billow noise in the column's own frame advected up the axis, fire from below with one shadow tap toward the crater, sky with one tap up; the axis solved per sample by two Gauss-Newton steps. Anvil: one sheet seen from below. Event smoke: CPU-sorted puffs from a baked billow atlas, soft-edged, lit by their body's normal. Lightning: 8 slots of uniform rows, channel + branches built in the vertex stage from a seed, double-sided ribbons; the CPU mirrors the envelope to light land and cloud. Fire: closed-form jets, a GPU-flown ring buffer of bombs, motes. Post: one scene pass, a hue-preserving bloom (Medium+), one output pass with heat shimmer masked by the bloom, calm zones, filmic, grade, grain. Six tiers.
motifsToAvoidReusing: Volcanoes and eruptions (a breached cone, a somma, fountains), lava rivers and fissure curtains, an eruption column bending into an anvil, mammatus lit from below, volcanic lightning (bolts, spider lightning, discharge), St Elmo's fire, a shock front ring through cloud, a smoke vortex ring, Strombolian bombs.

Lock (the Peel): a strip unzips and curls off the trunk lane nearest the piece at its own rows, revealing a wet band of the piece colour (its bark age); last ~12 pieces stand as bands and ripen away. Hard drop (the Knock): strip tears off whole, gloss pulse up the trunk, flakes. Clear (the Shed): a girdle sheet peels off at each cleared row on both near trunks; the ring blazes First Skin then ripens into the cleared row's ten cell colours. Four lines (the Great Moult): creak, moult front down every trunk, grove naked in lime, colour climbs back in flames; grove left younger. Combo: one canopy gap opens per link at a fixed station (sun-pool + shaft; pools = chain - 1) plus quickening bark clocks; release (the Set): curl curtain sized by peak. B2B (the Sunshower): persistent rain in the light, wet saturated bark. T-spin (the Unwinding): helical apple-peel strip, amber resin beads, scar lasts the level. Perfect clear (the Floor): mist drains to reveal the forest floor carpeted with the session's curls. Level (the Climb): camera rises a storey. Game over: Mistfall. No rainbow, no light from the card, no held colour, no blades, no hush, no spiral.
tech: WebGPURenderer on both backends, self-shaded MeshBasicNodeMaterial, no lights or compute. Trunks: one InstancedBufferGeometry unit tube deformed along a spine, near draw (<=8 instances, events) + far draw. Bark: 512^2 RGBA8 patch atlas (nearest ID view + linear edge-distance view, fwidth AA, far footprint fade), 256x1 age ramp. Closed-form air rbAir; rbFleck canopy gobo with penumbra from the 0.53 deg sun via CPU mips; backdrop paints impostor ranks, mist top and floor. 2D textures only (no Data3DTexture or lut3D). Event table u.events (112 vec4). One scene pass (MSAA High+), BloomNode Medium+, one output pass with calm zones; six tiers.

Game over pulls the light toward the blue hour; morning returns on the next run.

Hard drop: wider faster ribbon, a ring along the ground from the landing point, sparks. Clear: a line of light per row (the row's dominant pigment) climbs the strata through the whole land; pigment rises; rows laid into the record. Chain: a shower walks in from the horizon (cover darkens, rain veils, wet saturated rock, rain at the eye); a break after 4+ arcs a low rainbow across the valley (double after 7). Four lines: a rainbow tide climbs every bed + a flash flood of the rows' pigments in pulses down the river. T-spin: a pigment dust devil (helix) on the valley floor. B2B: mica glints. Perfect: painted clouds, every bed lights, double bow. Level up: hour step + a pale marker bed of light + an ash bed in the record. Game over: dusk and lanterns.
tech: WebGPURenderer on both backends; self-lit MeshBasicNodeMaterials. Land: a fan mesh (bearings x log-distance, 8 m-42 km) from three baked PNG heightfields (near 1024^2/2.2 km, mid 1024^2/8.4 km, far 512^2/40 km; RG height, B sky visibility, A drainage), half-float field textures with Sobel slopes; strata column 8192x1 sRGB with CPU mips; flutes from an erosion filter (Clay John) near the eye; sun-visibility render targets per field marched across all fields, repainted only when the sun moves; exponential haze + valley mist integrated along the ray. Sky dome with deck + cirrus + stars; cumulus banks as billow-heap cards (log-sum-exp union of sphere impostors). Events in the land shader (ribbon/wave tables sized in pixels via fwidth, slope-gated) and one instanced closed-form mote mesh. Post: bloom with hue-preserving knee following exposure, sun shafts (High+), hue-preserving filmic, warm/cool grade, calm zones. Six tiers.
motifsToAvoidReusing: Rainbow-striped badlands / strata bands cut by an eroded surface; light racing along a rock bed; bands of light climbing strata per cleared line; a flatiron range of zigzag-striped triangular faces; a hilltop pavilion with red lanterns and a boardwalk of lamps; golden poplar rows along a braided river; a pigment-coloured flash flood in pulses; cleared rows laid down as the newest rock beds; a dust devil for T-spin; a rainbow after a chain's shower. Fleet clichés it shares (disclosed): low sun with shafts at the golden hours, an hour wheel on level-up (the owner's standing rule), a spiral (the dust devil) at T-spin.
